title: Conditional κ = 7.26111344123732762670617e-4: gen4 response kernels and endpoint-aware composition of #279/#280
body:
κ = 726111344123732762670617 / 1000000000000000000000000000 = 0.000726111344123732762670617, conditional.

This combines #276's gen4 bit word, sixteen terminal sinks, 741 fresh response-kernel pivots, all 880 source-pair retimings from #279, 29 compatible transported entrances and all 440 early restorations from #280, and the latest 220 target-prefix squares from #279. The result is approximately 0.27% above #280's pinned 0.000724189082265949363570532 and 0.45% above #276's 0.000722869827347495. The bit supplier still binds, below the retained complex saving 0.000747454944651775.

### Contribution and composition repairs

The fresh gen4 kernel search uses donor-first response information sets. It finds 746 pivots/rank 1603, but sixteen sink deletions invalidate five rows. The final word therefore retains 741 pivots/rank 1552, rechecked on the actual compacted circuit. An eleven-sink alternative retaining all 746 rows was evaluated and priced lower.

Only 29 of #280's 60 transported entrances compose: eight helpers were deleted, nineteen conflict with existing response machinery, and four fail signed commutation through sink setup. The legal insertion cut is moved later and checked again; the survivors add entrance rank 522. All 440 early restorations then pass. These change helper terminal frames from rank 24 to 23, so the bank auditor must use P_final−P_initial rather than I−P_initial. It constructs and verifies the full nested-endpoint charts and every actual allocation.

Finally, all 220 target squares pass on this combined word. They remove 1,119 prefix additions and 239 recursive calls, a different histogram from the standalone public construction. Every gain is repriced from the final physical transcript; independently reported kappa gains are never added. Existing public mechanisms are credited, not claimed as new inventions.

Final inventory: 19,914 local physical registers; 16,394 helper roles; total added entrance rank 2,074; endpoint rank saving 440; local rank mass 422,844; 120 replicas; 341,356 banks per stage; literal stock 2,551,580; normalized stock 510,316; literal deficit 528,000.

The offline source-bound driver in `research/gen4-composed-endpoints120/verify.py` performs:

- All nine original #276 stages, retaining original producer and consumed-frame determinant obligations.
- Native sink, kernel, source-retiming, dirty-read transport, early-restoration and target-square transformations, with arbitrary dirty inputs and nonvacuous omitted-operation controls.
- Exact signed commutation and source-purity checks; all 19,914 local forward/inverse formal columns; independent prefix and integer frame audits; all 23,434 five-stage template columns and bridge controls.

title: Conditional κ = 7.26291692225845·10⁻⁴: 91 collective response-kernel families on helpers untouched by #283, at its own cut (+0.0248% over #283)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.26291692225845·10⁻⁴: 91 collective response-kernel families on helpers untouched by #283, at its own cut (+0.0248% over #283)

One self-contained package, `research/gen4-collective-families-283/` (PR #283's package with 91 rows appended, one contained block in its bank allocator, regenerated receipts), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 181572923056461298166587/(25·10²⁵) = 7.26291692225845·10⁻⁴** by #283's fixed-prime price, +1.80·10⁻⁷ over #283's 7.26111344123733·10⁻⁴ and +0.473% over #276's gen4 word; the bit side binds.

## Result

A census of the 13,944 plain dirty helpers of the gen4 word (12,352 distinct complete F₂ target responses of rank 1,760) enumerates the low-weight F₂ circuits among the responses — 1,616 twin pairs, 5,245 triples, 38,633 quadruples after twin expansion — keeps those with a nondegenerate common entrance inside all members' first required frames (616 / 1,131 / 4,490), prices them under the deficit-fixed ledger (φ(r) = r·ln(120/r); a quintuple is never net-positive) and packs them greedily with shared donors on nested chains. On the bare gen4 word this gives a 695-entry selection (416 pairs, 24 twin pairs entering on 16-dimensional intersections, 255 multi-donor families; model κ 7.24029·10⁻⁴ before any retiming), whose helpers largely coincide with #283's 741-pivot selection. On helpers that no part of #283 touches (its 1,612 kernel roles, 16 sinks, 60 transported candidates), **91 families remain net-positive — 87 quadruples and 4 triples**: (3, 3, 3, 3) with e = 2 × 49, (5, 5, 5, 5) with e = 4 × 10, families of first dimension 10–17 entering on e = r − 1 or r − 2; entrance rank 456, 14 donors shared. All are legal at #283's global cut 520,031, so they are appended to `inputs/kernel-original.json` in #283's schema and go through its sink remap and kernel transform unchanged.

| | #283 | this package |
|---|---:|---:|
| kernel pivots / entrance rank (with transports) | 741 / 2,074 | **832 / 2,530** |
| one-stage paid rank mass | 425,358 → 422,844 | 425,358 → **422,388** |
| literal stock (120 replicas) / normalized | 2,551,580 / 510,316 | **2,549,300 / 509,860** |
| κ (fixed-prime price) | 7.26111344123733·10⁻⁴ | **7.26291692225845·10⁻⁴** |

The ledger model predicted #283's price → 7.26291688·10⁻⁴; the package's pricers give exactly that before the fixed-prime refinement.

## The one code change (PROOF.md, section 3)

#283's `code/banks.cpp` tiles a residual-r role with four r-blocks and (30 − r) rank-4 fillers per bank; the 91 families need 30,060 rank-4 filler copies where #283's word leaves 10,380. The allocator now lets a residual group that would exhaust the rank-4 pool use rank-3 fillers instead (4r + 4b + 12k = 120 with b = (30 − r) mod 3), both remainders and the pool asserted, every bank width 120 and full; when the pool suffices the allocation is byte for byte #283's. Here only #283's own 29 rank-19 transported entrances switch (pattern [6 × 4, 3 × 32] in 870 banks; 3⁴⁰ banks 2,118 → 1,422). Without the change, 25 of the families fit the pool and give 7.26226544·10⁻⁴ (rows kept in `discovery/`).

## Checks

#283's verifier, otherwise unchanged, end to end: the nine #276 stages on the vendored immutable package; sink transform and audit; kernel transform (832 pivots, 13,136 compensation reads removed, 3,462 Q/Q⁻¹ gates, all 19,914 columns forward and inverse, omitted-operation controls non-vacuous); #279's retiming (880 gates), #280's transports (29) and restorations (440), the 220 target squares; independent legality and prefix audits (1,464,320 kernel equalities on 1,956 helpers); 23,434 global columns; bank review with the new allocation (4,923,000 assignments, chart bound unchanged, max 312 factors); price, fixed-prime price (47 constraints, adjacent grid rejected) and finite invoice; every receipt regenerated and pinned. The families were also replayed on the bare gen4 word with per-family omitted-setup and omitted-restore controls (`discovery/replay_families.py`).

## Verify

    sudo apt-get install -y g++ libboost-dev
    python -m pip install -r research/gen4-collective-families-283/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/gen4-collective-families-283/verify.py --output /tmp/gen4-collective-replay   # about 16 minutes locally; fresh directory outside the package

Prints the certificate `PASS_SOURCE_REGENERATED_COMPOSITION` with κ. The workflow runs it on Ubuntu with Python 3.11 and 3.13.

## Scope and limits

* Same conditional status as #276/#283 (finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses; no Lean certificate); #283's own correctness claims are inherited, not re-proved.
* The 24 e = 16 twin pairs and most multi-donor families of the bare-word selection sit on helpers #283 already uses and were not re-derived on its word; per-family cuts were not needed (all 91 are legal at the global cut).
* Diff against #283's package (`discovery/README.md`): `inputs/kernel-original.json` (+91 rows), `inputs/kernel-remapped.json`, `code/banks.cpp` (filler block), one sentence in `PROOF-PR283.md`, regenerated `expected/` and `RESULT.json`, `MANIFEST.json`, this package's notes and `discovery/`.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The composed word, the donor-first kernel selection, sinks, audits, pricers and the bank allocator extended here are Dugongue's (#283, on #254/#259/#272); the gen4 word is DreamingOfClouds' (#276); the retimings and target squares are rohanarun's (#279); the transports and restorations are utcorvusvolat-dotcom's (#280); the target-prefix mechanism is eumemic's (#268) on its source527 five-stage lineage; the five-stage layout is hcg890's (#234) with Jacob Sussman's construction. title: Conditional κ = 7.42785663120535e-4: gen5 — compile-cost-annealed pair and all-but-one modules on #276's gen4 bit word, five-stage completed banks
body:
**κ = 148557132624107/(2·10¹⁷) = 7.42785663120535e-4**, conditional, with the bit supplier binding.

| compared with | κ | gain |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| highest open claim when I wrote this (#284, 07:10 UTC Oct 10) | 7.26291692225845e-4 | **+2.27%** |
| #276's gen4 package, which this extends | 7.22869827347495e-4 | +2.76% |

This is a second structural change to the bit word. The gain does not come from frame or entrance tuning.
#276's gen4 word keeps its arc-aware local circuit. Its two **module circuits** are replaced by modules
annealed against the exact one-instance **compile cost**:

| Module | gen4 | gen5 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| pair + copied centre | 448 additions, debt 184 | 463 additions, 299 arcs, debt 164 |
| all-but-one | 34 additions, debt 12 | 32 additions, 21 arcs, debt 11 |

The virtual word needs 17,292 auxiliary roles: 612 fewer than gen4 and 1,616 fewer than PR200. The
generator is byte-identical to #276's; only its module data and frozen arcs change.

```sh
cd research/five-stage-gen5-banks
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt     # sympy==1.14.0
python3 -B verify.py --output /tmp/gen5-five-stage-verification     # about 5 minutes, no network
```

## What changed

There is one new self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5-banks/`, plus its own path-filtered
workflow. No existing file changes. The package is #276's package with the bit word swapped and the
constants re-pinned.

| one invocation, m = 120 | gen4 (#276) | **gen5 (this PR)** |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| virtual auxiliary roles | 17,904 | **17,292** |
| compensated reuse pairs | 1,494 | 1,406 |
| independent dirty registers R | 16,410 | **15,886** |
| independent entrances | 2,466 (ranks 20, 21) | 2,554 (ranks 17, 18, 20, 21) |
| literal stock (60 replicas) | 1,283,035 | 1,247,070 |
| normalized stock / deficit | 256,607 / 52,800 | 249,414 / 52,800 |
| bit coarse saving | 7.23392746398452e-4 | **7.43337804075788e-4** |
| κ | 7.22869827347495e-4 | **7.42785663120535e-4** |

The complex supplier is unchanged (PR234/PR193, coarse 7.47454944651775e-4). The bit side still binds, now
**0.55%** below it, so the complex supplier, for example #233's word (7.547e-4 in this layout per #256),
is about to become the lever.

## Why compile cost and not debt

Minimizing additions − carrier arcs alone is the wrong objective. A cyclic-interval all-but-one module
reaches the proven floor of debt 10, yet costs the whole word 4.5%, because it cuts roles into many
small rank steps.

So both modules were annealed on the exact one-instance compile cost: a single module instance compiled
in its real geometry with the generator's own compiler. Closed-form node-rank evaluators reproduce that
compile up to a constant offset, which allowed long annealing runs (10⁷ or more iterations each).

| Region | Debt change | Raw a_b change (whole word) |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| pair module | 184 → 164 per instance | +1.13% |
| all-but-one | 12 → 11 | +0.83% |
| together | | +2.76% |

The predicted and actual gains agree to 0.01%. `gen5bit/README.md` has the details.

The rank-17 entrances need width-7 bank blocks, so 10 mixed (7¹² 4⁹) banks are used per stage, as
source527 used mixed 11/4 banks. The total residual width is even, so the 60-replica tiling is exact.

## What `verify.py` checks (9 mandatory stages, same as #276)

- **virtual:** the PR168-v4 checker on the virtual word, with all 5 controls rejected; then PR200's
  physical-word proof (1,710 changed frames, 1,406 handoffs, the physical row, the physical word on all
  19,406 columns over F₂ and the integer decoder), with 4 adverse controls rejected.
- **raw / bit:** the census of every physical path (both reflections), the event emitter, parity fusion
  (1,500,000 even payload ADDs elided), the five-stage global lowering (479,144 paid calls, deficit
  4,400), and exact h=24/m=120 geometry, including one actual entrance basis of each rank 17, 18, 20
  and 21.
- **scalar:** the retained source527 scalar program on all 19,406 F₂ columns and the signed integer
  decoder in both directions, with 11 actual-context corruptions rejected. The controls now always pick
  odd-coefficient responses, since even ones vanish over F₂.
- **primes:** 25,802 consumed bases, at most 118 bits, every residual below 2⁸⁰.
- **banks:** 411 exact charts and all 4,765,800 assignments; the 2,554 rank-5a completions are removed.
- **complex, math, finite:** both moment engines with the full 10⁻¹⁶ fallback, all 47 strict
  inequalities and 7 margins (the adjacent κ grid point is rejected), and the literal finite bill with
  757,938,545,400 selector calls.

`gen5bit/producer/regenerate.py` rebuilds the five pinned bit-word files byte for byte, in about 2
minutes. I replayed the package in my working environment, in a clean Python 3.12 + sympy 1.14.0 venv
from another directory, and from a fresh git checkout. All three give the identical certificate.

Outside the package, a read-only audit:

- reproduced the coarse value and κ with its own 400-bit ball arithmetic;
- re-derived every frame, all 1,406 aliases, every target chronology, the F₂ replay on all 19,406 columns
  and the helper ledger with exact arithmetic;
- confirmed that no check was weakened relative to #276.

## Status

This is a conditional finite construction with exactly the retained interfaces of #276, #210 and #234.
There is no new Lean and no multiplier benchmark. The composable gen4 mechanisms (#279–#283: response
kernels, retimings, target-prefix squares, early restorations) should carry over to gen5 with the
constants re-pinned. I have not done that here.

## Attribution

Everything credited in #276 is retained:

- Henry Grant (hcg890)'s #234 and Jacob Sussman's five-stage construction;
- eumemic's source527 package and #168 generator and checker;
- Chafik Boukhalfa's #200 physical-word classes;
- Evan McKinney's #197 and Rohan Arun's #237 banks;
- Avi Eisenberg's #193 complex helper;
- icekylinx's #144 framework;
- the PR207, PR216, PR211, PR230 and PR210 notices.

The gen5 modules (the module search with exact compile-cost evaluators and annealing, run by Claude
Opus 5.5 agents) and the integration were prepared with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), via Claude Code. See `NOTICE.md`.

title: Extreme-frame retiming on #284's gen4 word: conditional κ = 7.26319877913759e-4 (+0.0039% over #284; below #285)
body:
**κ = 726319877913758986831841 / 10²⁷ = 7.26319877913759e-4** (conditional), **+2.8186e-8 (+0.00388%) over #284** (7.26291692225845e-4) by #284's own fixed-prime price.

This is an improvement to the **gen4 line only, not a repository record**: #285's gen5 word (7.42785663120535e-4) is higher. It is posted for the method, which is word-agnostic and stacks on later packages.

## Change

An ADD's frame must contain its operands' current frames (MOVEs only go up) and lie inside the frames their next uses need. Between those bounds the choice is free. Each operand role then pays one recursive child for each frame jump. At fixed rank mass the price rewards fewer, wider children (≈ −Σ r ln r), and `r ln r` is convex, so the optimum for a unit is an **extreme**:

- the **join** of the operands' previous frames, or
- the **meet** of the frames their next uses require.

Either can be a new frame. Each is built exactly as an integer basis/annihilator pair.

| pass | unit | moves |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | equal-frame ADD component (54 gates) | 21 joins (14→13 ×12, 16→15 ×4, 12→11 ×4, 12→10) |
| 2 | single ADD (components split) | 40 meets (10→15 ×20, 18→19 ×16, …) and 1 join |

Rank mass (422,388 local) and stock (2,549,300 literal / 509,860 normalized) are unchanged. Afterwards, fresh scans of both unit types find no improving extreme. The same scan gives +2.4958e-8 on #283. On #280 it finds nothing, because the slack comes from the kernel pivots and target-prefix squares.

## Verification

`research/gen4-extreme-frame-retiming/verify.py --pr284 <pinned #284 checkout> --output <fresh>` runs these steps in order:

1. **#284's complete verifier, freshly.** All nine PR276 stages, sinks, kernels and the 91 families, retiming, transport, restorations and targets; its certificate must pass.
2. **Frame audit before each frozen pass.** Each new frame is checked against the exact word it is applied to: complementary ranks, `P_r ⊆ G ⊆ N_r` for every operand role, and exact join/meet dimension.
3. **Local emission.** The ordered non-MOVE stream must be unchanged except for the selected frame fields; only the affected roles' MOVEs are rebuilt.
4. **#284's own native checkers on the new word.** Legality, multi-cut prefix, exact bank charts and allocation, all five-stage formal columns, the rational price, the finite invoice, and the fixed-prime 47-constraint assembly with adjacent-grid rejection.

A local full replay passed in about 10 minutes, almost all of it #284's verifier. The package has its own path-filtered workflow, which checks out pinned #284 separately. No existing file changes.

**Outlook.** On gen5's raw word the same scan automatically rediscovers #279/#280's 880 source-pair retimings and finds 135 further gate moves. Proxy price is about 7.4354e-4, and the five-stage columns pass on that word. It is **not claimed here**: it needs a gen5 bank/invoice admission path.

Conditional on #284's (and #283's) retained interfaces; not an unconditional theorem, a Lean proof or a runtime result. Credit: chafreaky (#284), Dugongue (#283) and the lineage they credit; lydakis's #275 motivated the generalization.

body:
Conditional κ = `372068073050471/(5·10^17)` = **7.44136146100942e-4**, +1.35 × 10⁻⁶ (+0.182 %) over [#285](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/285) (7.42785663120535e-4) and above [#289](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/289) (7.44127392470948e-4). ## Change

**Stage 3 — second concave descent after the squares (111 gates, +87 calls, higher κ).** On the word after the squares, the same concave-descent search with constructed candidate frames (the minimal join and the maximal meet of a gate's neighbouring operand frames, not only frames the word already uses) finds 111 further internal ADD reassignments onto 48 new bases. Local paid histogram delta {1: +63, 2: +198, 3: −126, 4: −48, 5: +24, 7: −48, 9: +24, 12: −24, 14: +24, 18: −63, 19: +63}: the local call count *rises* by 87 (five-stage calls 473,599 → 474,034) at unchanged rank mass 2,746,720, but the concave weight Σ r·ln(120/r) falls, which is what the moment certificate prices, so κ rises by 1.54 × 10⁻⁸ over the two-stage package (7.44120696397042e-4) and by 8.75 × 10⁻⁹ over #289. The new bases are explicit rational rows in `descent2-selection.json`; `descent_transform.py` registers them, checks nondegeneracy, both reflected annihilator ledgers and the exact integer source span of every non-target operand, and `prime_check` evaluates their determinants with every other actual basis (26,109 unique nondegenerate endpoint bases). `raw_ledger.rebind_descent2` recounts the profile; `bank_check` (471,480 banked calls) and `verify.py` pin the new counts and κ.


**Stage 2 — target-prefix compression (220 squares).** After the retiming, every target reads rank-20 entrance helpers at a 20-dimensional frame; in each of 220 squares of four targets each helper is read by exactly two of the four, so the dependent target's prefix response is the F₂ sum of its three square-mates'. Its 1,100 frame-20 reads are omitted; it receives `t −= p_j` at the zero frame at the cut and `t += p_j` at the square's common nondegenerate 21-dimensional frame at the close (1,320 setup/restore additions): ZERO →(20)→(1)→ 21 becomes ZERO →(21)→ 21, delta {1: −221, 2: −8, 17: −1, 18: −7, 20: −212, 21: +220}. The transform is eumemic's `target_transform.py` from #268 unchanged apart from the stream count; it recomputes every literal dependency from the actual word, rebuilds every MOVE, checks nesting, endpoints, COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate bases and both all-column replays with an omitted-setup control, and rebinds the raw ledger. Downstream constants follow (575,052 weighted ADDs, coefficient counts, event hash; signed prefix bounds 46,393 / 2,282,970 unchanged); per-replica bank call count 471,045.

**Stage 1 — retiming.** 
#285's gen5 pipeline (prepare → physical producer → parity fusion → lowering) carries **no frame retiming**. The concave-descent search behind #263/#279 finds 904 single-gate frame reassignments on gen5's parity-fused word — PR244's common-delivery-frame retiming for gen5's 880 unborrowed source-pair mixes (per pair the paid children of ranks 1, 1, 20, 22 become 21, 21, 2) plus 24 further internal gates. Local paid histogram delta {1: −1760, 2: +880, 6: +24, 7: −48, 8: +24, 20: −880, 21: +1760, 22: −880}; 880 local recursive calls per invocation disappear at unchanged rank mass 411,356. Five-stage profile: 474,744 calls (was 479,144), rank mass 2,746,720, deficit unchanged; per-replica bank call count 472,190 (was 476,590).

`descent_transform.py` consumes the frozen `descent-selection.json` (record bindings, old-basis hashes, explicit rational new bases) and, like PR244's `retiming_transform.py`, rebuilds every MOVE from the selected gate needs and independently checks: the byte-identical scalar/COPY projection, nested chains, fixed source/dirty/target endpoints, unchanged COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate endpoint bases, both reflected annihilator ledgers, the expected histogram delta and rank mass, and the exact **integer** source span of every non-target operand inside its new frame, recomputed from the actual word. `raw_ledger.rebind_descent` recounts the five-stage profile; `bank_check` and `verify.py` require the new counts and κ; `prime_check` retains the determinant obligation for producer frames the retiming removes (PR244's rule, as in #279).

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5-banks/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5-banks/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5-descent-verification
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, a new output directory outside the package; no network. About 6 minutes.

## Scope and credits

Exactly #285's hypotheses and conditional interfaces (all-size compiler, weighted chart, restored rows, selectors, routing, prime supply, precision/recovery, complex symbolic correctness, analytic reduction). No new Lean build or practical benchmark is claimed. The other levers the gen4 lineage accumulated (entrance regauge, kernel families, target-prefix compression, early restorations, fixed prime) are not yet applied to gen5 and compose on top of this.

DreamingOfClouds (#285, #276): the gen5/gen4 bit words and their five-stage completed-bank packages; eumemic (#244, #210, #234 lineage): the common-frame retiming this reproduces and the package machinery; hcg890 and Jacob Sussman (#234); Evan McKinney (#197); and the retained lineage. title: Negative results from a search for a new coding mechanism: m = 2 closed on both sides, flag theorems, closed routes (no new κ)
body:
Scoping note, **no new κ**: one README, six standard-library checkers and one data file under
`research/negative-results-paradigm-search/`. No existing file changes.

**Why.** Every frontier witness (7.43e-4, #285, at the time of writing) gets its saving from the same label
(index-coding) mechanism, with a per-level coding gain of about 1.003 at m ≈ 110–120. We searched for a different
mechanism that could at least double the saving exponent on both the bit and the complex side. We found none. This PR
records what we tried and why each route fails, so others need not repeat the work. It complements Swapnil Jain's
closed-ideas list and its papers P1 and P2, and notes the overlaps.

**Main new results.** Each is stated in its model; nothing here bounds integer multiplication itself.

| Side | Result | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Complex | **m = 2 never saves for any frames in GL₄(C).** All monomial maps are free (arbitrary phases, non-Clifford, approximate-arithmetic and "y-phase" frames included), gate coefficients are arbitrary complex numbers, and gates may join registers at different frames. Exact FO certificate on Λ²C⁴. | [cert] |
| Complex | **m = 3: no torus-invariant FO certificate can exist** in characteristic ≠ 2 (Fano matroid). | [proof] |
| Complex | **m = 3, W = 2 is closed in the dilation normal form for every s ≤ 5**: window lemmas plus Gröbner-decided coefficient systems. In the full register model, inserting one free element anywhere still gives no saving. | [proof]/[cert] |
| Complex | Exact non-Clifford diagonal frames in C[y]/(y^r+1) reduce to Clifford frames plus 2^k-th roots of unity. Approximate arithmetic is legitimate but does not relax the exact group-ring identity. | [proof]/[arg] |
| Bit | **Flag theorem:** with any per-role Levi targets (invertible lower triangular, mixed or not), any rational frames and any payload field, W·m − s ≤ Σ_{up frames} (m/2 − rank A). So **m = 2 never saves**. | [proof] |
| Bit | **Theorem G₀:** the flag bound survives mid-network Levi maps, the non-abelian model where every shear is a commutator and all character bounds fail. The proof uses Sylvester rank functions on group rings of solvable quotients; a separate adversarial review found it correct. | [proof] |
| Bit | **Abelian m = 3: s ≥ 2W + 1** for every W (tight-frame lemma). | [proof] |
| Machine operations outside the frame model | Masked gates reduce to clean ancillas; clean ancillas are blocked; Fourier-duality retirement of the bit primitive is circular; multiplicative index maps obey a valuation lemma; carry-free maps are not linear-time; nonlinear controlled-shift frames keep target cost m and make a nonlinear shear cost 2. | [proof]/[arg]/[cert] |
| Coding-gap seeds | Per-session sign gauges do not rescue an isometric frame embedding of Braverman–He's PG(2,9) code: the signed incidence system is unbalanced. Cayley seeds have gap ≤ D/\|S\|. Common-frame networks with s ≤ 8 never save, for any frames. | [cert]/[proof]/[arg] |

Section 2 of the README also records earlier routes we tried and discarded on 8–9 October:
- in-class ideas on the paired-cube design: 5-pair ports, register recycling, source-assisted words, nested-chain
  modules, centre restructuring, the bridged schedule and others;
- new-primitive ideas: different-frame gates, characteristic-0 Tanner codes, small instances, centre decoders, more
  than one saved dimension per role, cover structure, cross-level schemes.

Section 3 lists what is still open: complex m = 3 at W = 2 (two or more insertions) and W = 3; bit m = 3 at small W;
the full non-abelian bit model at m = 2; non-smooth nonlinear frames in the register model; and large m, where no
construction exists but the bounds allow up to about m/2.

```sh
cd research/negative-results-paradigm-search/checks
python3 -B complex_m2_lambda2_certificate.py   # m = 2 complex certificate, < 1 s
python3 -B multiplicative_index_maps.py
python3 -B fourier_duality_f3.py
python3 -B nonlinear_frames_m1.py              # about 2 s
python3 -B flag_model_cliques.py 2             # (3: about 10 s)
python3 -B bh_sign_gauges.py
```

**Scope.**
- The packaged checkers cover the m = 2 complex certificate, the Fourier-duality identity, the multiplicative BFS,
  the nonlinear m = 1 census, the flag-model cliques and the PG(2,9) sign test.
- The flag theorem, Theorem G₀ and the m = 3 lemmas are written proofs. Their large searches (SAT, MITM,
  Gröbner) are reported, not packaged.
- Section 2's rows summarise earlier exploration notes.

**Credits.**
- Paired cubes: icekylinx (#144). Source-assisted compression: icekylinx (#184). Pair donors: ikeboy (#193).
- Design ceiling: DaysSky (#201). Structural barriers: huxint (#203). Lucas-parity obstruction: GamingPuzzled (#231).
- Bridged schedule: J. A. Sussman (#209). Five-stage suppliers: hcg890 (#234).
- Closed-ideas list and P1/P2: Swapnil Jain.
- The PG(2,9) instance: Braverman and He.

Prepared by eumemic with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0.

title: Extreme-meet frame retiming (87 gates) on target-compressed gen5 word: kappa = 7.44127392470948e-4
body:
# Extreme-meet frame retiming on target-compressed gen5 five-stage completed banks

**κ = 186031848117737/(2.5·10^17) = 7.44127392470948e-4**, conditional, with the bit supplier binding: **+6.70 × 10⁻⁹ (+0.0009 %)** over updated PR #287 (7.44120696397042e-4).

## Summary of the Construction

This package builds directly on DreamingOfClouds' `five-stage-gen5-banks` (#285) with three chained post-parity transformations:

| Stage | PR Origin | Gates / Groups | Local Paid Calls | Exponent $\kappa$ |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Base Word** | #285 (DreamingOfClouds) | — | 476,464 | $7.42785663 \times 10^{-4}$ |
| **1. Concave Descent** | #244 / #287 (Rohan Arun) | 904 ADD gates | 474,744 | $7.43528852 \times 10^{-4}$ |
| **2. Target Prefix** | #268 (eumemic) / #287 (Rohan Arun) | 220 square groups | 473,599 | $7.44120696 \times 10^{-4}$ |
| **3. Extreme-Meet** | #289 (This package) | 87 meet gates | **471,480** | **7.44127392 \times 10^{-4}** |

### 1. Concave-Descent Retiming (`descent_transform.py`)
Reassigns 904 ADD gate frames using local descent on the concave paid-rank objective $\sum r \ln(120/r)$. Each unborrowed source-pair mix executes at its rank-22 common delivery frame (PR244) plus 24 internal gates. Local paid histogram delta:
$$\{1: -1760, 2: +880, 6: +24, 7: -48, 8: +24, 20: -880, 21: +1760, 22: -880\}$$
Eliminates 880 local recursive calls at invariant rank mass 411,356.

### 2. Target-Prefix Compression (`target_transform.py`)
In each of 220 squares of four targets, rank-20 entrance helpers are shared: each dependent target's frame-20 prefix response is the $\mathbb{F}_2$ sum of its three square-mates. Its 1,100 reads are omitted; it receives $t \mathrel{-}= p_j$ at the cut zero frame and $t \mathrel{+}= p_j$ at the square's common nondegenerate 21-dimensional frame at close (1,320 setup/restore additions; 575,052 weighted ADDs). Frame transition $\text{ZERO} \to (20) \to (1) \to 21$ becomes $\text{ZERO} \to (21) \to 21$. Histogram delta:
$$\{1: -221, 2: -8, 17: -1, 18: -7, 20: -212, 21: +220\}$$

### 3. Extreme-Meet Frame Retiming (`extreme_transform.py`)
Extends the word by identifying 87 mutually role-disjoint, target-stream-disjoint ADD gates whose operands admit exact common nondegenerate meet frames ($F_{\text{meet}} \subseteq F_{\text{old}}$ with $F_{\text{meet}} \subseteq F_{\text{next},a}, F_{\text{next},b}$):
- **24 gates** retimed from dimension $12 \to 14$
- **63 gates** retimed from dimension $18 \to 19$
- **Zero role collisions:** All 174 operand roles are distinct.
- **Zero target interference:** All operations strictly disjoint from target streams ($r < 1760$ or $r \ge 3520$).
- **Concave gain:** $\Delta \Phi = \sum r \ln(120/r) = \mathbf{+10.924353}$ at invariant rank mass $2,746,720$.
- **Paid recursive calls:** Reduced from $473,599 \to \mathbf{471,480}$ (total five-stage records: 670,267).
- Verified byte-identical scalar/COPY projections, nested chains, and integer source spans across all 19,406 formal variables.

## Lineage and Contributor Chain Credit

Apache-2.0 applies. All original headers, licenses, notices, and AI-assistance disclosures are preserved across the lineage:

title: Conditional κ = 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴: 450 collective response-kernel entries on #285's gen5 word, after #287's descent and target squares (+0.080% over #287)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴: 450 collective response-kernel entries on #285's gen5 word, after #287's descent and target squares (+0.080% over #287)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/` (#287's package with one added stage), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 186178624839407/(25·10¹⁶) = 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴**, +5.94·10⁻⁷ over #287's 7.44120696397042·10⁻⁴ and +0.259% over #285's gen5 word; the bit side binds (bit coarse 7.45270·10⁻⁴, complex 7.47455·10⁻⁴).

## Result

The collective response-kernel stage of #282 (gen4) and #284 (on #283), re-derived on gen5 and inserted after #287's two stages: **450 entries with per-entry cuts** — 260 twin pairs (244 on a line, 16 on a rank-3 entrance) and 190 multi-donor families (151 quadruples, 39 triples): the pivot's complete F₂ target response is the XOR of its donors', all members share a nondegenerate common entrance of dimension 1–18 inside their first required frames, 33 donors serve several entries along nested chains. The pivot's compensation reads are deleted, it enters at the common entrance, each donor pays its shear there after the cut and the inverse at the full frame.

| one invocation, m = 120 | #285 | #287 | this package |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| entrances | 2,554 | 2,554 | **3,004** |
| literal stock, 60 replicas | 1,247,070 | 1,247,070 | **1,244,515** |
| bit coarse saving | 7.43338·10⁻⁴ | — | **7.45270·10⁻⁴** |
| κ | 7.42785663120535·10⁻⁴ | 7.44120696397042·10⁻⁴ | **7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴** |

**Census on gen5** (after #287's stages): 13,332 plain dirty helpers, every compensation read before the helper's first other use (gap ≥ 41,240 records), so each entry gets its own cut, bound by content; responses of F₂ rank 1,760 (nullity 11,572); 1,220 twin classes; low-weight response circuits 2,402 triangles and 20,003 quadruples at class level; with a common cut and a nondegenerate common entrance: 292 pairs, 276 triples, 1,103 quadruples. Greedy packing under the deficit-fixed φ ledger (φ(r) = r·ln(120/r)) keeps 450 (entrance rank 1,022); the model reproduces #287's κ exactly and predicted this κ exactly. The members are plain dirty helpers, disjoint from the targets whose reads #287's squares delete and from its retimed source-pair mixes.

## Checks

`kernel_transform.replay` runs all 19,406 formal columns forward and inverse on the emitted word, rejects both omitted-gate controls (2,405 / 757 wrong rows) and checks the prefix relation for every entry; then every stage of #287's verifier runs fresh — virtual, raw, bit (with #287's descent and target stages), scalar, primes (545 charts ≤ 576 factors, normalizer bound 815), banks (pivot residual widths tiled by (r⁴, 4³⁰⁻ʳ) banks on top of gen5's own patterns, every bank width 120 and full; selector calls 932,937,188,400 < 2⁴⁰), complex, math, finite — with ten omitted-stage negative controls; the geometry stage samples an actual entrance basis for every rank present. Every #287 literal the rewrite changes is a recomputed pinned value in `expected/kernel-pins.json`, asserted by `pins.pin`; none is dropped (`KERNEL-PROOF.md` lists them).

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5-collective-kernels-verification   # about 4 minutes; not under -I

Prints `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_ENTRIES_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION` with κ. The workflow runs it and #285's generator check on Ubuntu (Python 3.11, 3.13).

## Scope and limits

* Conditional finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses (no Lean certificate). #285 and #287 are open; their word and stages are inherited unchanged, not re-proved.
* The bit side is now 0.29% below the complex supplier (#193's word, 7.47455·10⁻⁴ in the five-stage layout). #233's complex word gives 7.547·10⁻⁴ in that layout (Lean-checked through #256 and jacobalansussman/wht-power-saving-lean#2); its gcert/1 certificate is a drop-in for this package's complex stage (verified separately, κ unchanged while the bit side binds) and will matter once bit-side gains exceed the margin.
* Not exploited: pivots of residual width 3 or 4; quintuple families (never net-positive under φ); the 928 twin pairs whose first frames do not intersect.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The gen5 word and its package are DreamingOfClouds' (#285, on #276); the descent and target-square stages and the package this extends are rohanarun's (#287); the target-prefix mechanism and the kernel-stage form are eumemic's (#268, on the source527 lineage); the response-kernel mechanism, collective kernels and the tiling rule are Dugongue's (#254/#259/#272/#283); the five-stage layout is hcg890's (#234) with Jacob Sussman's construction. This package contributes the gen5 censuses, the 450-entry selection, the generalised stage on gen5, the tiling, the re-pinned checks and the discovery scripts.

body:
# Conditional κ = 7.45513573133379·10⁻⁴: early restorations and terminal sinks on the gen5 kernel word, with #233's complex word as supplier (+0.107% over #290)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5-restorations-sinks/`, with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 745513573133379/10¹⁸ = 7.45513573133379·10⁻⁴**: +0.1073% over #290's 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴, above the rungs stacked on #290 (#291–#293, best 7.44729·10⁻⁴), and +0.187% over #287. Bit coarse 7.46070·10⁻⁴, complex coarse 7.54736·10⁻⁴; the bit side binds with a 1.16% margin.

## What it is

The #290 package (#285's gen5 word, #287's 904-gate descent and 220 target squares, our 450 collective kernel entries) with three changes, each a stage or input of the same Python pipeline, each priced on the whole word (the φ-ledger model predicted every κ below exactly before the stage was built):

| step | mechanism (credited) | census on gen5 | κ |
|---|---|---|---|
| #290 | — | — | 7.44714499357628·10⁻⁴ |
| complex supplier → #233's word | #233/#256 (ours), Lean-checked in jacobalansussman/wht-power-saving-lean#2 | gcert/1 certificate replaces #193's | unchanged (bit binds), complex cap 7.47455 → **7.54736·10⁻⁴** |
| **440 early helper restorations** | #280 (utcorvusvolat-dotcom), endpoint-aware banking as in #283 (Dugongue) | at the first cleanup ADD (record 601,737): 440 rank-20-entrance helpers whose single remaining incidence is a −= b, with entrance, both frames and a nondegenerate rank-23 join | 7.45272862652714·10⁻⁴ (+0.075%) |
| **8 terminal sinks** | #283 (Dugongue; source527 lineage) | 16 match the shape; 8 whose targets are not read by #287's squares are legal (the other 8 would need a downward move) | **7.45513573133379·10⁻⁴** (+0.032%) |

The complex swap does not change κ by itself; it keeps the restorations' and sinks' gains (+0.107% together) from being capped by #193's complex supplier, which sits only 0.29% above #290's bit side.

## Checks

`python3 -B verify.py` runs twelve fresh stages — virtual, raw, bit (with #287's stages), kernel, **restore**, **sink**, scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite — with twelve omitted-stage negative controls:

* restore: 1,768,348 crossed-gate commutation checks; all 19,406 columns forward and inverse; omission control rejected (440 wrong rows); both reflected ledgers; completion P_σ + I − P_E, and the geometry stage rejects the old I − P_σ residual;
* sink: all 19,398 remaining columns forward and inverse; three omission controls rejected (32 / 24 / 24 wrong rows); each removed helper frees exactly 24 rank; the 4,400 deficit re-checked at R = 15,878;
* banks: charts built on (E ∩ σ⊥ | σ | E⊥), 985 charts (440 new), max 576 factors; literal stock 1,244,515 → 1,242,935; role census checked against the removed roles;
* complex: #233's gcert/1 program through the package's complex stage unchanged in logic (labels, splice, scalars, precision guard below 2⁴⁸; all complex mutation controls rejected), complex coarse 754736418878859/10¹⁸ pinned at the 10⁻¹⁸ grid;
* every changed literal is a recomputed pin in `expected/kernel-pins.json` (`pins.py` now also refuses one name with two values).

body:
# Conditional κ = 7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴: gen5b — an exactly optimal local design and a debt-10 all-but-one module on #285's word, with #287's stages re-derived and #233's complex supplier (+0.348% over #287)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5b-banks/`, with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 373354860481239/(5·10¹⁷) = 7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴**, +0.348% over #287 and +0.525% over #285; bit coarse 7.47268·10⁻⁴, complex coarse 7.54736·10⁻⁴ (the bit side binds). This is a change of the bit word itself, before any entrance lever: it stands above #295's composed 7.45514·10⁻⁴ on its own, and the kernel, restoration and sink stages of #290/#295 can be re-derived on it.

## The word

#285's generator is run byte for byte with #285's compile-cost-annealed pair module and two new module data files:

* **Local design.** An exact model of the generator's per-cube arc rule (`discovery/local_model.py` reproduces the compiler's 29 additions / 13 arcs / debt 16 on all 220 cubes) and a CP-SAT search over all 15¹² recipe-tree choices (`discovery/cpsat_local.py`) prove **debt 16 optimal in this class** — #276/#285's design is optimal — and find an alternative optimum (28 additions, 12 arcs) that admits **1,726** compensated reuse pairs instead of 1,406.
* **All-but-one module.** The module's arc rule is combinatorial (verified frame-exactly on all 132 instances by `module_model.py`) and outputs can never be donors, so debt 10 is a floor; a symmetric CP-SAT model (`cpsat_abo_sym.py`) attains it with 35 additions and 25 arcs, against #285's annealed debt 11. #285 observed that a cyclic-interval debt-10 module costs the word 4.5%; this one lowers the word's descent cost 910,000.8 → 907,245.3 (−0.30%) with #285's local design and to 905,892.5 (−0.45%) with the alternative one.

| one invocation, m = 120 | gen5 (#285) | **gen5b** |
|---|---:|---:|
| virtual auxiliary roles | 17,292 | **17,160** |
| compensated reuse pairs | 1,406 | 1,726 |
| independent dirty registers R | 15,886 | **15,434** |
| independent entrances (ranks) | 2,554 | 2,234 (20 × 2,182, 21 × 34, 18 × 16, 17 × 2) |
| literal stock (60 replicas) | 1,247,070 | **1,236,750** |
| κ with #287's descent + target squares | 7.44120696397042·10⁻⁴ (#287) | **7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴** |

#287 ships frozen selections only; `discovery/descent_search.py` and `target_search.py` implement its stated rules (greedy concave descent of Σ r·ln(120/r) to frames on the operands' chains; squares with the literal F₂ response dependency, cut at the first target MOVE, close at the common next-need frame). On #285's word they reproduce #287's 904 gates and 220 squares exactly; on gen5b they find 904 and 220, committed as the package's selections. The complex supplier is #233's word (gcert/1 certificate of #256, Lean-checked in jacobalansussman/wht-power-saving-lean#2): with #193's supplier the bit side would sit only 0.025% below the cap.

## Checks

The new word passes both retained checkers (PR168-v4, 5 mutation controls rejected; PR200 word classes, formal identity, 4 adverse controls rejected), and `regenerate.py` reproduces the five pinned bit files byte for byte. `verify.py` runs all nine stages fresh — virtual, raw, bit (descent and targets), scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite — with nine omitted-stage negative controls. Every #287 literal the new word changes is recomputed and re-pinned (word sizes, entrance histogram, path census 17,194, parity counts, scalar events and hash, bank patterns: (3⁴⁰) 531 → 51 and (24⁵) 159,984 → 158,400 per stage, 4,630,200 assignments, 250 charts, selector calls 736,388,225,400, κ); no check is dropped.

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5b-banks/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5b-banks/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5b-verification       # about 4 minutes; not under -I
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5b-banks/gen5bit/producer/regenerate.py --work /tmp/gen5b-regeneration

## Scope and limits

* Conditional finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses (no Lean certificate for the bit side). #285 and #287 are open; their generator, pair module and stage code are reused unchanged.
* The pair module (debt 164 in #285) was not improved here (2.7·10⁶ annealing steps at debt 184 on gen4 found nothing; trivial bound 56). The alternative local design raises the weighted payload ADDs (753,472 vs 566,912), which only enters the finite bill; all its checks pass.
* Not composed here: the kernel (#290), restoration and sink (#295) stages; their re-derivation on gen5b is in progress.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The generator and gen4/gen5 word design (including the pair module and the compile-cost method) are DreamingOfClouds' (#276, #285); the descent and target-square stages are rohanarun's (#287; target-prefix mechanism eumemic's #268); the five-stage package is eumemic's source527 lineage on hcg890's #234 layout and Jacob Sussman's construction; the complex word is ours (#233/#256) on ikeboy's #193 and icekylinx's #144. This PR remains as the restoration stage composed with #291's second descent (its restoration-only rung, 7.45273e-4 on #290's word, matches #295's restoration-only figure); the two accountings agree.

## Change

**PR280's early restoration of cleanup helpers, on gen5.** [#280](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/280) (utcorvusvolat-dotcom) restored 440 gen4 helpers early; the gen5 lineage (#285 → #287 → #290 → #291) branched from #276 and never had it. The same census on the gen5 word after the descent, target-square, kernel and second-descent stages finds the same shape: at the first `cleanup_gate` ADD (record 601,802; no COPY/ERASE follows), **440 helpers `a`** have exactly one later scalar incidence, a write `a -= c·b` with a donor `b` unwritten in between, both at 22-dimensional frames whose rational span `E` is a nondegenerate 23-dimensional frame; all helpers and donors are distinct and disjoint. The write commutes over the integers with every crossed gate (none reads `a`, writes `a` or writes `b`), so `restore_transform.py` moves it to the cut: `a` and `b` advance to `E`, the unchanged ADD runs there and `a` retires at `E` instead of climbing to the full frame; `b` continues as before. Two rank-2 climbs per pair become three rank-1 climbs: local histogram delta {1: +1320, 2: −880}, local rank mass −440, priced literal stock 1,244,515 → 1,243,415. The transform checks the commutation conditions, the unchanged scalar-event multiset (byte-identical prefix, suffix minus the 440 writes), the exact integer source spans of both operands inside `E`, nesting, data endpoints, COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate endpoint bases and both reflected ledgers; `scalar_check` replays all 19,406 columns forward and inverse on the emitted word (row bounds unchanged: 67,127 / 2,360,408).

**Admission of helpers that retire below the full frame** (`RESTORE-PROOF.md`). A restored helper with entrance σ (dim 20) and endpoint `E` (dim 23) changes content only in the residual `D_(E−σ)` of rank 3 (#280's accounting); its single direction `E^⊥` is never touched (all of its frames nest inside `E`) and is completed together with σ:

title: Conditional κ = 7.50237961741364·10⁻⁴: kernels, early restorations, terminal sinks, a post-sink retiming and addition reordering on the gen5b word (+0.473% over #296)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.50237961741364·10⁻⁴: kernels, early restorations, terminal sinks, a post-sink retiming and addition reordering on the gen5b word (+0.473% over #296)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5b-kernels-restorations-sinks/`, with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 187559490435341/(25·10¹⁶) = 7.50237961741364·10⁻⁴**: +0.473% over #296's gen5b word (7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴), +0.633% over #295, +0.822% over #287. (Earlier versions of this PR: 7.49899215319498·10⁻⁴ without the last two stages, 7.49920356821633·10⁻⁴ with the post-sink retiming.) Bit coarse 7.50462·10⁻⁴, complex coarse 7.54736·10⁻⁴ (#233's word); the bit side binds with a 0.57% margin — with #193's complex supplier (7.47455·10⁻⁴) this word would now be complex-bound.

## What it is

#296's package (the gen5b bit word: #285's generator and pair module with an exactly optimal alternative local design and a debt-10 all-but-one module; #287's descent and target squares re-derived; #233's complex supplier) with the three transcript stages of #290 and #295, each re-screened on gen5b and priced on the whole word (the φ-ledger model reproduces #296's κ exactly and predicted each row below exactly):

| stage (census on gen5b) | mechanism | φ | κ | gain |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| #296 base | — | — | 7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴ | — |
| **1,720 collective kernel entries** — 920 twin pairs (904 on a line, 16 on rank 3) and 800 families (375 quadruples, 425 triples); entrance rank 2,192 | #254/#259/#272 (Dugongue), stage of #282/#290 | −3,799.1 | 7.49121118627047·10⁻⁴ | +0.323% |
| **440 early helper restorations** (cut at record 757,526) | #280 (utcorvusvolat-dotcom), endpoint banking #283 | −886.6 | 7.49686102247225·10⁻⁴ | +0.075% |
| **7 terminal sinks** (R 15,434 → 15,427) | #283 (Dugongue) | −333.7 | 7.49899215319498·10⁻⁴ | +0.028% |
| **second concave-descent retiming after the sinks** — 113 gates (31 operand-chain frames, 34 constructed join/meet frames, 36 connected pair blocks), 77 new bases | #287/#291 (rohanarun), #286 (GamingPuzzled), #289 (gupt1156), #270 (utcorvusvolat-dotcom) | −33.3 | 7.49920356821633·10⁻⁴ | +0.003% |
| **addition reordering** (two rounds, 237 moves): a single addition moved past its sibling incidences into the frame of a neighbouring incidence — 213 root deliveries y += h from a rank-21 frame into y's next rank-22 frame, 22 forward gates from a rank-18 back to an earlier rank-16 frame, 2 more in round 2; exact over Z because no crossed gate reads its destination or writes its source | found while testing Khattar–Gidney's conditionally clean ancillae (arXiv:2407.17966), whose literal class is empty here | −496.6 | **7.50237961741364·10⁻⁴** | +0.042% |

gen5b is much richer in kernels than gen5: 952 twin pairs share a cut and a nondegenerate common line (292 on gen5); helper responses have F₂ rank 1,760 and nullity 11,440 over 13,200 plain helpers; with a common cut and entrance there are 952 pairs, 2,104 triples and 3,807 quadruples.

## Checks

`python3 -B verify.py` runs fifteen fresh stages — virtual, raw, bit (descent + targets), kernel, restore, sink, descent2, reorder, reorder2, scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite — with fifteen omitted-stage negative controls. The reorder stage re-derives every frozen move on the actual word (record content, the anchor frame's exact basis, the crossed-interval rule, disjoint operand sets), runs the F₂ replay of all columns forward and inverse, an omission control (932 wrong rows), an independent integer replay mod 2⁶¹ − 1 with random dirty inputs, the MOVE rebuild with both reflected ledgers, and #287/#291's exact source-span rule on every gate of its output. The post-sink retiming (`descent2_transform.py`, #287's transform with final frames read from the actual post-sink state so restored helpers keep their early endpoints) keeps every check of #287's descent (byte-identical scalar/COPY projection, nested chains with every MOVE rebuilt, fixed endpoints, COPY lifetimes, exact integer operand spans, nondegenerate frames, both reflected ledgers) and adds a forward and inverse F₂ replay; the deficit stays 4,400. Kernel: 38,036 compensation reads removed, 5,790 setup/restore gates, all columns forward and inverse, omission controls 3,190 / 1,438 wrong rows, prefix relation checked for every entry. Restore: 1,767,480 crossed-gate commutation checks, omission control 440 wrong rows, completion P_σ + I − P_E. Sinks: omission controls 28 / 21 / 21 wrong rows, each removed helper frees 24 rank, deficit re-checked at R = 15,427. Banks: literal stock 1,236,750 → 1,229,750, 807,350 banks, 910 exact charts, 3,954 entrances; the 1,574 residual-23 pivots are tiled as (r⁴, 24, 4²⁴⁻ʳ) — width 120 and full — because #283's (r⁴, 4³⁰⁻ʳ) rule runs out of rank-4 blocks on this word. Every changed literal is a recomputed pin; nothing is dropped. The two intermediate packages (kernel only; kernel + restore) also pass `verify.py` end to end.

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5b-kernels-restorations-sinks/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5b-kernels-restorations-sinks/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5b-krs-verification   # about 5 minutes; not under -I

The workflow runs it and the bit-word regeneration on Ubuntu.

## Scope and limits

* Conditional finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses (no Lean certificate for the bit side; the complex word is Lean-checked via #256). #285, #287 and #296 are open; inherited stages are reused unchanged.
* Not composed: #280's transported dirty entrances (almost no candidates once the target squares are in place), restorations whose join is the full frame (34), quintuple families (never net-positive), and the retiming rungs stacked on #290 (#291–#293), which were bound to the gen5 transcript.
* `KERNEL-PROOF.md` and `LEVERS-PROOF.md` describe the mechanisms with their gen5 counts (#290/#295); the README carries this word's counts.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The response-kernel mechanism, collective kernels, sinks and endpoint banking are Dugongue's (#254/#259/#272/#283); early restorations are utcorvusvolat-dotcom's (#280); the gen4/gen5 generator, pair module and compile-cost method are DreamingOfClouds' (#276/#285); the descent and target-square stages are rohanarun's (#287; target-prefix mechanism eumemic's #268); the five-stage package is eumemic's source527 lineage on hcg890's #234 layout and Jacob Sussman's construction. This package contributes the gen5b word (#296), the censuses and selections on it, the generalised kernel stage (#282/#290), the ports of the restoration and sink stages to this pipeline (#295), the (r⁴, 24, 4²⁴⁻ʳ) tiling and the complex supplier (#233/#256).

title: Verify a 12-helper co-retiming improvement on pinned PR #299
body:
## Summary

Add a standalone verifier, construction note, and exact receipts for a small conditional improvement to [PR #299](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/299), pinned at `5f6bd3fbc0e6796dd31263cef1f06dc968186f64`.

The construction introduces 12 early helper restorations, explicitly undoes six overlapping old restorations, and co-retimes their donor, blocker and partner deliveries. The complete measured local histogram delta is `{1:+18, 2:-12}`, with residual-family delta `{2:+12, 3:-18, 4:+6}`.

Under the same retained source/compiler/all-size interfaces:

- Conditional kappa: `749906929903449/10^18 = 0.000749906929903449`, versus PR #299's `0.000749899215319498`.
- Gain: `0.000000007714583951`, approximately `0.00103%` relative.
- Bit coarse saving: `750469712644613/10^18`.
- Literal stock: `1,229,735` (15 fewer); unreplicated paid calls: `482,665`; rank mass: `2,455,070`; unchanged deficit: `4,400`.

The partner co-retiming is essential. Omitting it creates a forbidden rank-23 to rank-22 target-frame descent. The final ledger charges the extra partner-carrier split. An earlier optimistic root-only ledger is superseded.

## Dependency and diff scope

PR #299 remains an unmerged dependency. This PR adds only `research/gen5b-coretime12/`; it does **not** copy PR #299's changes into the diff against main, modify PR #294, or assume a main checkout already contains PR #299's inputs.

A small data-only fetcher downloads the 11 exact immutable inputs listed in `inputs.json` and verifies every byte count, SHA-256 and Git blob hash. Existing downloaded inputs can be reused. No large upstream word/frame/selection bundles, original executables, private research notes, or generated full scalar/bank tables are committed.

## Verification

All 49 targeted tests pass on Python 3.12.14, and `run_checks.py --check` reproduces every committed receipt exactly as JSON data. The aggregate check also passes from an unrelated working directory. Only newly authored code executes.

Coverage includes:

- Both complete 55,985-addition suffixes and all 18,954 independent entry columns, forward/inverse, over F2 and the integers.
- Exact absolute-coefficient majorant equality, plus an independent 172,944-commuting-swap certificate and conservative scalar-norm transport.
- All 60 affected frame paths, 212 exact rational containments, and 12 verified post-descent partner setups.
- All 18 changed endpoint charts, at most 142 factors, within retained 576/815 chart/normalizer allowances.
- Explicit assignments for all 15,427 helper roles, 925,620 role/replica occurrences per stage and 4,628,100 across five disjoint stage namespaces.
- Full-width packing, exact moment enclosures, three bootstrap steps, all 47 strict outer constraints, and rejection of adjacent coarse/kappa grid points.
- Changed displayed finite coefficient `90386288803484701 < 2^80` and conservative 103-bit payload below the 104-bit cap.
- Negative controls for missing restoration, old-restoration undo, partner promotion, bank capacity, duplicated role, noncommuting scalar swaps, malformed arithmetic and changed source bytes.

From the new directory:

```sh
python3 -B fetch_inputs.py --destination /tmp/coretime12-inputs
export CORETIME_SOURCE_DIR=/tmp/coretime12-inputs
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s . -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 -B run_checks.py --check
```

Use `run_checks.py --output-dir /tmp/coretime12-results --write-streams --check` to emit full scalar streams, the compact role-address table and exact chart factor programs.

## Evidence boundary

No additional open changed-stage construction obligation is identified by these checks. The original prefix and source admission, unchanged finite compiler, weighted selectors/charts, restored-row, routing, prime, recovery, complex-supplier and analytic/all-size interfaces remain inherited hypotheses. They have not been rerun or reproved here. The bit payload remains F2; the stronger integer suffix identity is not a claim that the full parity-filtered supplier is an integer decoder.

The displayed finite-bill calculation does not assign a value to the retained theorem's unknown `C_full`. Neither `make verify` nor the upstream complete admission suites were run. This is a conditional research improvement, not an unconditional multiplication bound or full machine-checked theorem. Main's selected certificate, production guards and manuscript patches remain unchanged.

## Attribution and assistance

The source package is Chafik Boukhalfa's PR #299, prepared with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. This contribution preserves the inherited lineage, including DreamingOfClouds, Rohan Arun, eumemic, utcorvusvolat-dotcom, Dugongue, Evan McKinney, Henry Grant, Jacob Sussman, ikeboy, icekylinx, James Chang, sennemmi and their credited dependencies. The complete immutable source notice is linked in `NOTICE.md`.

New material is Apache-2.0 and was prepared with substantial OpenAI assistance. Separate AI-assisted checks are not human peer review, an OpenAI endorsement or proof-assistant verification. No global priority or optimum claim is made.

## Additive fresh PR325 certificate: 480 partner-mix retimings

The new sibling `research/gen5b-shared-kernels/p10-pr325-partner-retimings/` derives exactly 480 partner setup retimings, from rank 2 to rank 18, directly from immutable PR325 head `0eca9340a3df6141b8e71a41638c3937b3522888`. The resulting **conditional saving parameter κ is 0.000770612425424136**, improving the published paid892-presink value by 0.000000604335525339.

Credit: the replacement word and four new PR325 producer/data changes belong to DreamingOfClouds, with declared Anthropic Claude assistance. The acquired, hash-pinned original NOTICE preserves the detailed earlier contributions and assistance disclosures. The general retiming/descent mechanism remains credited to Rohan Arun's PR287 work and Anthropic Claude assistance. Our contribution is the fresh derivation of these 480 choices, independent complete source/local/global verification, fresh bank allocation, exact invoice and price, and portable packaging, with substantial OpenAI assistance. No old role/frame/chart or retiming-selection data is imported. Upstream programs are retained only as inert text.

The arbitrary-dirty argument explicitly separates address geometry from payload values. Rational address matrices induce permutations of complete F2-valued role arrays; ADD is pointwise XOR. The pinned common-array-frame theorem in `proof/primary/03-motifs.tex`, lines 146–185, applies after checking every common gate frame, exact edge quotient, fixed endpoint, unchanged logical scalar operator and complete COPY/transform/read/erase episode. These finite premises are independently verified on all 398,660 local records and 12,885 rational nondegenerate frames. The exact source/frame geometry includes all 480 changed setups, 960 source chains, 40,125 MOVE containments and 563,928 regular-source supports.

The global audit reconstructs all 119,604,000 mapped frame records, 300 namespaces, 720 phases, 960 route conjugacies and 100 positive copied-work overrides. Actual projector/conjugacy identities and negative-direction controls pass. All 2,430,000 role/replica/stage assignments fill complete banks, with no completion children. Two independent, equivalent endpoint-chart constructions need at most 139 and 141 factors, both within the unchanged 150-factor allowance.

The literal profile is stock 658,800; 14,514,000 children; rank mass 65,757,600; deficit 122,400; maximum rank 42 < 50. The finite coefficient is 24,857,617,667,871,401. Exact full-fallback pricing, all 47 strict assembly inequalities and rejection of the adjacent κ grid point pass. The portable aggregate has 40 regression tests and 28 compact receipts, with 21 bank and 12 emission negative controls. All 12,884 local basis-mutation controls reject. Thirty-two concrete artifacts match the independently frozen originals byte-for-byte.

The publication baseline is head `def71b9eb828aaa31d5e9602b6fc10ac9b844c12`, tree `04d58da0bcb5b9c51b31c6f431d820901e51464b`. All 354 previous contribution files remain unchanged. Immutable source acquisition and replay work from any working directory. Generated tables and streams are not committed.

All new finite gates are discharged conditionally. Production primitive/compiler realization, uniform eligible-prime and weighted routing interfaces, restored rows, ordinary leaves, complex/full-C, precision/recovery and analytic all-size hypotheses remain inherited. This is not an unconditional all-size theorem or an optimality claim. See the sibling README, proof, exact frame contract, provenance, independent adapter review and deterministic receipts for the precise scope.

The portable replay passes 33 regression tests and freezes 31 deterministic receipt hashes. Prepared with substantial OpenAI assistance. Existing contributor credits and Apache-2.0 notices are preserved; the new packet's `NOTICE.md` identifies inherited ideas and the source chain.

## Original pinned PR302 contribution

## Summary

Add a standalone verifier and construction note for 70 shared-donor rank-one kernel pivots, composed with pinned [PR300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/300) and the 12-helper co-retiming from [PR301](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/301). A fully checked 72-pivot fallback and PR299-based arithmetic checkpoint are retained separately.

Under the retained source/compiler/all-size interfaces, the combined 70 case gives:

- Exact conditional kappa: `749940157923873/10^18 = 0.000749940157923873`.
- Bit coarse saving: `750502990558158/10^18`.
- Literal stock `1,229,560`; unreplicated calls `483,425`; rank mass `2,454,720`; deficit `4,400`.
- 70 pivots, 87 distinct donors, 157 affected helpers, and 601 setup/restore shear pairs.
- Displayed finite coefficient `90466979917115701 < 2^80`.
- Corrected sink-aware payload `12927738210344389271740351838400 < 2^104`, with strict positive gap `7354671393307281152206899447616`.

The separate 72-pivot fallback on PR300 plus co-retiming gives kappa `0.000749936120273400`, stock `1,229,555`, calls `483,455`, rank mass `2,454,710` and a 102-bit payload. The PR299-based 72 checkpoint gives `0.000749917402998347`. No global priority or optimality claim is made.

Comparisons here use the pinned older heads; newer upstream revisions exist, and this PR does not claim the best current bound.

## What is new

Pivots may share donors on the same rank-one entrance line. Pivot and donor sets remain disjoint, so the shear incidence matrix squares to zero and the setup/restore factors commute. Exact response relations, a reproduced common read cut and complete local frame paths certify the changed bit construction compositionally under the inherited decoder.

The packet includes independent role-to-bank allocation, not just inventory arithmetic: all 15,427 helper roles and all 60 replicas are assigned, totaling 925,620 assignments per stage and 4,628,100 across five disjoint stage namespaces. The 70 case uses 161,432 full width-120 banks per stage. Its 171 exact chart programs cover all 314 new role uses plus the 18 co-retiming endpoint programs, with at most 489 factors, within the retained 576/815 allowances.

PR300's 89 scalar events match original forward/old-kernel incidences; their 154 helper operands are disjoint from the broader 84-stream co-retiming closure and all new-kernel members. All 440 restoration and seven sink entries match PR299 semantically. Exact determinants additionally verify 65 distinct selected PR300 bases. The finite bill includes all 1,202 new scalar additions per stage and the actual sink redirects/mixed target paths.


`run_checks.py --output-dir /tmp/shared-kernel-results --check` also generates complete factor programs and deterministic bank address tables; add `--write-streams` for the full co-retiming suffixes.

The aggregate checks include all 18,954 columns of the compositional bit identities; the full 55,985-event co-retiming suffix over F2/Z/absolute majorants in both directions; changed chronological frames; exact chart factors; complete role assignments; conservative finite/scalar bounds; exact moment brackets; three bootstrap steps; all 47 strict outer constraints and adjacent-grid rejection. Only independently authored verification code was executed.

## Evidence boundary

title: A stronger complex supplier: compile-cost-annealed complex modules, five-stage complex saving 7635/10⁷ (+1.17% over #233; no new κ)
body:
**A stronger complex supplier (no new κ by itself):** re-annealing the three query modules of the
source-assisted complex word gives these five-stage complex savings:

| pair recipe | this word | PR #233's word (PR #256) | PR #193's word |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| PR #233's maximum-weight reuse pairs | **7635/10⁷** | 7547/10⁷ (**+1.17%**) | |
| PR #193's parity-avoiding pairs | **7586/10⁷** | | 7474547/10¹⁰ (+1.50%) |

The current frontier is bit-bound, about 0.6% below #233's complex price (7.54736·10⁻⁴): #303/#300 at
κ = 7.49983·10⁻⁴ (12:00 UTC Oct 10), and #299 with bit coarse 7.50462·10⁻⁴. This
package raises the complex cap it is approaching **from 7.547·10⁻⁴ to 7.635·10⁻⁴**. It lifts nothing on
its own, because the bit supplier binds.

```sh
python -m pip install numpy==2.3.5 scipy==1.17.0
python3 -B research/complex-module-anneal/verify.py      # about 12 minutes, no network; -O is refused
```

## What changed

There is one new self-contained package, `research/complex-module-anneal/`, plus its own path-filtered
workflow. No existing file changes. It is built in the mould of #256: the same vendored `gcert_emit.py`,
Jacob Sussman's `gx/gx.py` (unchanged) and the PR #233/#202 references.

The source-assisted complex word of #184/#194 calls three PR #168-v4 query modules:
- the pair module (n = 10, 22 instances);
- the all-but-one module (n = 9, 110 instances);
- the disjoint-triple module (one instance).

They were re-annealed against the exact compile ledger of the aligned word, as #285 did on the bit side.
The new modules are not smaller in total (2,462 additions against 2,353), but they are cheaper to compile:
the frame flow needs **R = 9,160** slots instead of 9,412.

| program (gcert/1, five-stage m = 110, W = 4v + R) | modules | pairs | R | N | `gx.check1` | certified a |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| control | PR #168 v4 | PR #193 recipe | 9,412 | 262,944 | accepted | 7469/10⁷ |
| control | PR #168 v4 | PR #233 recipe | 9,412 | 262,944 | accepted | 7522/10⁷ |
| **result** | **re-annealed** | PR #193 recipe | **9,160** | 257,400 | accepted | **7586/10⁷** |
| **result** | **re-annealed** | PR #233 recipe | **9,160** | 257,400 | accepted | **7635/10⁷** |

Each certified value has exact rational bounds, and the next 10⁻⁷ grid point is rejected. The controls run
the same recipe on PR #168 v4's own modules: fresh carrier arcs, PR #200's descended frames, then the two
pair recipes. They measure the modules' effect alone: **+1.50% and +1.57%**.

The recipe is slightly weaker than PR #168's inherited physical layer on the old modules: −0.07% against
#193 and −0.33% against #233. The comparison above is therefore conservative.

## What `verify.py` checks

`verify.py` checks every pin and rebuilds PR #202's 308 files from the vendored PR #233 package. It runs
two anchors:
- `aligned_word.py` reproduces `source_aligned_local_v4.py`'s seven outputs byte for byte;
- PR #194's word reproduces #256's certificate sha and Sussman's #193 histogram.

Then, for each of the four words, it runs:
- the module contracts;
- the frozen arcs through `compile_closure`, and the frozen frames through the script's own forward
  closure;
- `paircheck.py`, an independent pair re-check with five mutation controls;
- PR #168's `physical()`, a randomized mod-2⁶¹−1 replay with three controls;
- PR #200's complete complex checker as admission;
- PR #184's flow and exact rational lift, and PR #194's 13-check contract;
- PR #256's emitter, then a documented sign-convention normalization to the star-rule scatter;
- `gx.check1` with the exact scalar identity, on the raw and the normalized program, plus Sussman's `gxcore`
  mirror on the committed program;
- the ledger and the exact five-stage price;
- byte comparison of the four committed certificates and `expected.json`.

## Verification

- **Replays:** two fresh-copy replays in other working directories (Python 3.14, numpy 2.3.5, scipy
  1.17.0) reproduce every certificate byte for byte.
- **Independent audit:** read-only, no package code.
  - Exact two-sided moment bounds reproduce all four values: 7469, 7522, 7586 and 7635.
  - Its own GF(2) label and exact scalar replays agree, as does Sussman's `gxcore` mirror.
  - It re-checked the modules, pairs and layers, including `make_layer.py` reproducing all 12 frozen
    layer files.
  - It found no blocker.

## Status, honestly

- **κ:** no new κ by itself; the bit side binds everywhere today.
- **Lean:** no Lean build. `gx.check1`, Sussman's Python reference checker, accepts all four programs. His
  Lean bridge, `refcheck.py` and `gxdry.py` were not run.
- **Layout:** the five-stage formula H5 = 5·H_inv + 2v(e42 + e21 + e46 + e4), W = 4v + R is applied at
  R = 9,160, as the bit packages apply it at several R. The deficit m·W − rank = 4v − 5·cst = 3,080 is
  unchanged. Confirmation is left to the layout's authors.
- **Integration:** to compose this into a five-stage package, the complex code there must accept a
  #193-shaped program at R = 9,160. It is hard-wired to #193 today, though #296 and #299 already
  generalised it for #233's word. The programs here use the star rule, as that code expects.

## Follow-up (not packaged)

A centre-sharing variant (pair-module root = centre, about 10 lines in `Graph.finish`) measured about
+2.7% in exploration. It needs a reviewed code change and is left for whoever owns `Graph.finish`.

- **chafreaky:** #200's complex checker, #233's reuse pairing and #256's gcert emitter.
- **Jacob Sussman:** gcert/1, `gx.check1`, the gxconv unit convention and the five-stage layout.
- **eumemic:** the #168 modules and `paired_cube_physical`.
- **DaysSky:** #162's arcs.

The module annealing (exact compile-ledger evaluators and annealers, run by Claude Opus 5.5 agents) and the packaging
were prepared by DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), via Claude Code. Every upstream notice is retained; see
`NOTICE`.

# Conditional κ = 7.51458925311258·10⁻⁴: addition reordering on #305's weighted gen5b composition (+0.0424% over #305)

## What it adds

The reorder stage of #299 (where it gave +3.18·10⁻⁷ on the plain gen5b composition), re-screened on #305's final word (after its kernels, second descent, restorations and sinks) and appended after the sinks:

| step | moves | local delta | φ | κ |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| #305 | — | — | — | 7.51140529238897·10⁻⁴ |
| reorder | 237: 212 root deliveries y += h moved past h's sibling deliveries from a rank-21 frame into y's next rank-22 frame; 25 forward gates into an earlier frame of a neighbouring incidence | {2: +237, 3: −217, 4: −25, 5: +5, 6: −20, 8: +20, 21: −212, 22: +212} | −495.07 | 7.51458164306940·10⁻⁴ |
| reorder2 (screen re-run on the reordered word) | 2 forward gates 18 → 16 | {2: +2, 3: −2, 4: −2, 5: +2} | −1.19 | **7.51458925311258·10⁻⁴** |

Each move is a single addition moved, within its incidence window, into the frame of a neighbouring incidence; it is exact over Z because no crossed gate reads the moved addition's destination or writes its source, and rank mass is unchanged (the φ ledger, φ(r) = r·ln(120/r) at fixed deficit, predicted every κ exactly). The lever was found while testing Khattar–Gidney's conditionally clean ancillae (arXiv:2407.17966), whose literal class is empty on these words (every transcript operation is invertible, so no register's content is ever a combination of the others').

**Fixed point.** A re-census of every class on the final word (kernel families, early restorations, sinks, descent, reorder with a widened window) found nothing above 10⁻⁸ (best: 12 descent pair blocks, +2.4·10⁻⁹), so no further stage is added.

`reorder_transform.py` (byte-identical to #299's) re-derives every frozen move on the actual word — record content, the anchor frame's exact basis, the crossed-interval rule, disjoint operand sets — and runs the F₂ replay of all 18,944 columns forward and inverse (0 wrong rows), an omission control (999 / 66 wrong rows, rejected), an independent integer replay mod 2⁶¹ − 1 with random dirty inputs (identical on every register), the MOVE rebuild with both reflected ledgers, and #287/#291's exact source-span rule on every gate of its output. Each selection is bound to the hash of the word it was screened on (input `9c8dd18e…` = #305's final word → `96fd1fa3…` → `4b5edb89…`). `verify.py` is #305's with the two stages required (14 stages, 14 omitted-stage controls); everything else of #305's package is unchanged, the new values are pinned in `expected/kernel-pins.json`.

## What it adds

#310's w3 word (the PR #249/source527 cohort word with a design-T cube layer, twin condensation and a SAT line-pair module) is admitted by #310 with no transcript stages. This package re-derives the stages of the gen4/gen5 lineage on it and prices against the stronger complex supplier, which becomes necessary: with #233's supplier (7547/10⁷) the complex side would bind at 7.541308566883·10⁻⁴.

| step | items | local Σφ | κ after the step |
|---|---|---:|---|
| #310 | – | 1,068,458.57 | 7.52893499605·10⁻⁴ |
| 1. kernel stage | 433 response-kernel families (twin pairs, integer and F₂ triples, multi-donor families with shared donors on nested chains; multi-seed packing) + 85 zero-response singles; entrance rank 840; 132 new frames | stock 162,123 → 161,843 | 7.53675926616·10⁻⁴ |
| 2. target-prefix + plateau | 45 F₂ target-prefix groups (window dependency R_t = Σ ±R_p, k ≤ 3); 660 identical five-gate components retimed into new dim-15 frames | −1,025.22 | – |
| 3. reorder | just-in-time MOVE normalisation + 172 commuting addition relocations (two rounds, fixed point) | −326.55 | bit cap 7.54549816771·10⁻⁴ |
| 4. complex supplier | #304's program through #309's source-bound adapter, priced at 7635/10⁷ | – | **7.54549816771·10⁻⁴** |

The φ ledger (φ(r) = r·ln(120/r), deficit fixed; ≈ −6.45·10⁻¹⁰ κ per φ on #310's ledger) predicted the stage-2+3 gain at +8.72·10⁻⁷ against +8.74·10⁻⁷ verified. **Reviewer note:** the 85 zero-response singles are helpers that the w3 redesign left without prefix reads; they enter directly at their first frame and are carried as kernel entries without partners (≈ 407 φ). Sinks (582 shape matches), early restorations (440 candidates; they would need final-frame changes that #310's legality checker rejects) and cleanup sandwiches (none on w3) are not composed. #311's 209 squares are bound to record indices on #310's word and were not re-screened on this one; this package's 45 target-prefix groups are its own screen on the kernel word.

* Kernel: exact rank and 9I − J Gram nondegeneracy of all 132 new frames; the F₂ kernel identity of every family on the original prefix responses; E inside every member's first frame; no source owner or donor key among members, pivots and donors disjoint; GF(2) replays with random dirty inputs (sources unchanged, targets t ⊕ x, helpers restored, every register equal to #310's); controls omitting the Q and Q⁻¹ gates rejected.
* Target-prefix and plateau: nested chains; forward and inverse F₂ all-column replays; an integer replay mod 2⁶¹ − 1 equal on every register; the exact source-span rule (0 violations).

* #304 supplier: #309's adapter archive pinned by hash and member inventory, extracted fresh, `gx.check1` on the actual #304 program with its label, scalar, splice, cover, router, precision and row guards.
* #310's native chain on the final word: legality (518 selections); all 23,627 global and 22,172 compact F₂ columns (payload 97 bits < 104); exact charts for 4,265 new frames and 22,118 changed projectors (≤ 342 factors); bank review (made generic: census and width-120 tiling read from `stages/bank-tiling.json`, an integer-programming tiling; 105,523 banks per stage, stock 809,215 / 161,843, 3,026,400 assignments); price (two moment engines, eight levels, 47 strict constraints, adjacent grid rejected); finite invoice (coefficient 58,364,056,416,171,201 < 2⁸⁰, selector 571,950,117,600 < 2⁴⁰).
